csv_scope_of_work: Consultants to perform design services for the Riverfront Trail System Connection from James M. Robb State Park to Red Cliffs Drive on Highway 340. This project requires the connection of existing concrete trails located on the south end of the James M Robb State Park on the west side of Highway 340 to the trail at Red Cliffs Drive on the east side of Highway 340 by crossing under the Colorado River Bridge at the north abutment. This work also requires the elimination of the informal Colorado River boat ramp along the east side of Highway 340.
